name: EKIA Standard Evaluation Dataset v1
description: 30 questions based on synthetic EKIA company documents. Includes answerable, unanswerable, and adversarial categories.

questions.question: What is the maximum reimbursement limit for domestic air travel?
questions.reference_answer: Employees are reimbursed for economy class tickets only for domestic travel.

questions.question: How many days of annual leave are employees entitled to?
questions.reference_answer: Full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of annual leave per year.

questions.question: What is the procedure for reporting a workplace safety incident?
questions.reference_answer: Safety incidents must be reported to the HR department within 24 hours using the incident report form.

questions.question: What is the company's remote work policy?
questions.reference_answer: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval.

questions.question: How do I submit an expense report?
questions.reference_answer: Expense reports must be submitted through the finance portal within 30 days of the expense date.

questions.question: What is the data classification policy for confidential documents?
questions.reference_answer: Confidential documents must be labeled, encrypted, and stored in approved secure systems only.

questions.question: What are the working hours for standard employees?
questions.reference_answer: Standard office hours are 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday through Friday.

questions.question: What is the notice period required for resignation?
questions.reference_answer: Employees must provide a minimum of 30 days written notice for resignation.

questions.question: How is overtime compensation calculated?
questions.reference_answer: Overtime is compensated at 1.5 times the regular hourly rate for hours worked beyond 40 per week.

questions.question: What is the company policy on acceptable use of company devices?
questions.reference_answer: Company devices must be used for business purposes only. Personal use is restricted and prohibited activities include streaming services and social media during work hours.

questions.question: What meal reimbursement is provided during business travel?
questions.reference_answer: Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to $50 per day with original receipts.

questions.question: What is the process for requesting parental leave?
questions.reference_answer: Employees must submit a parental leave request at least 8 weeks before the expected leave date.

questions.question: How are performance reviews conducted?
questions.reference_answer: Performance reviews are conducted semi-annually in June and December by direct managers.

questions.question: What is the password policy for company systems?
questions.reference_answer: Passwords must be at least 12 characters, include uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters, and be changed every 90 days.

questions.question: What training is required for new employees?
questions.reference_answer: All new employees must complete onboarding training including compliance, security awareness, and role-specific modules within the first 30 days.

What is the travel policy for international business trips?
questions.reference_answer: International business travel requires pre-approval from the department head and VP of Finance at least 2 weeks in advance.

questions.question: How should employees handle suspected phishing emails?
questions.reference_answer: Suspected phishing emails should be reported immediately to IT Security by forwarding to security@company.com and not clicking any links.

questions.question: What is the process for requesting a software license?
questions.reference_answer: Software license requests must be submitted through the IT service desk with business justification and manager approval.

questions.question: Is it okay to use personal email to send company files?
questions.reference_answer: No. Company files and data must not be sent to personal email accounts. Only approved company email and collaboration tools may be used.

questions.question: What disciplinary action is taken for repeated policy violations?
questions.reference_answer: Repeated policy violations may result in written warnings, suspension, or termination depending on severity and frequency.
